items.title: New hurricane season record as 'historic' El Niño leaves Atlantic eerily quiet
items.summary: The Atlantic hurricane season has reached its climatological peak, but a strong El Niño means no hurricanes have formed this year.

items.title: Scientists discover the human heart can regrow muscle after a heart attack
items.summary: Researchers have shown for the first time that human heart muscle cells can regrow after a heart attack.
